mina-sales: Heads up — Silverline Bank asked for our POC evidence bundle: SOC2 summary, ISO excerpt, network redacted diagram, presigned upload, and signed pen-test attestation. Can we deliver by EOD tomorrow?

ash-se: Do we need to change any scope if they plan to test on Dedicated for POC? That may affect the attestation wording and pricing.

rachel-compliance: We can produce the bundle. Pen-test attestation needs legal sign-off but I can draft now. ISO and SOC2 summary are ready. Need an upload path from infra.

dan-security: For the attestation: confirm if they want raw pen-test deliverables. If yes, we require an NDA addendum. Otherwise we provide exec summary + attestation. Also confirm requested signatory (CTO/CISO).

infra-ops: Upload bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence/silverline-poc/ . Presigned PUTs supported (24h). Staging CIDR: 35.90.10.0/24. Gave write ACL to silverline-upload@silverline.com.

rachel-compliance: I'll assemble bundle and drop a README_UPLOAD.md with filenames & redaction checklist.

mina-sales: I'll confirm signatory and whether they need raw reports. Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer after we have the draft. :thumbsup:
